fact: The August 2023 diagnostic says the Safety Nets and Basic Services project built a social registry of poor households only in the regions it covered (World Bank 2018), and that creating a national cadastro social, begun under that project, still had to be addressed within a national programme.
title: Estudo de Diagnóstico do Sistema de Proteção Social na Guiné-Bissau
publisher: República da Guiné-Bissau / UNICEF (Oxford Policy Management consultants)
